doc.title: Mrs. P. Thomas Agnes Brown Interview, 1960-10-12

title: 1917 court document and papers given to Tulane
summary: A September 1917 Illinois court filing naming LaRocca, Shields and others against Roger Graham; Mrs. Brown gives the originals to the interviewer.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: Thank you very much, Miss Brown. Uh, let's see. In the District Court of the United States for the Northern District of Illinois' Eastern Division, you have Max Hart, Henry Ragus, Dominic James LaRocca, Lawrence Shields, Anthony Sbarro, and Edwin B. Edwards. Sbarro is spelled.

Complainants versus Roger Graham, defendant, state of Illinois' county of Cook. Sbarro. And, uh, that's sworn, let's see, subscribed and sworn to before me this day of September 1917. I guess we can get that from the, uh, court records up there. We can get a copy of this from the court records.
Well, you can have that. I have the original. Oh, we can keep this? I'll give you that.
Oh, we'd love to have this. Then I won't have to read it. You can save my voice.
You can have, you do very good.
You can also have this too.
Oh, that is wonderful. We really appreciate that.
Oh, I got thousands. Oh. You've got plenty left. Yes.
